# ChemDraw drawing elements

`drawing.cdx` and `drawing.cdxml` are the project owner's own test drawing,
saved by ChemDraw 26.0.0.6599 on macOS. They hold ChemDraw's basic shapes in
every style of its Drawing Elements palette: plain, dashed, filled, shaded and
shadowed circles, ovals, rectangles and rounded rectangles, and plain, dashed,
wavy and bold lines. Lines are saved twice, as a legacy `graphic` superseded
by an `arrow`, as ChemDraw writes them. They are external application output,
not files written by ReShiki.
